verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Parahelp issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent. The closest items are adjacent controls: per-tool approval gating and auto-approve, general role-based access, and a third-party Pylon API token the user supplies to Parahelp. None of these is a credential-issuance capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
